messages:
sam.marketing: Need a tight creative pack for next-week launch: 2 hero tiles (1200x628, 800x800), 1 compact diagram (latency vs cost with 3 callouts), and 2 email header sizes. 48-72hr turnaround. Can design take it?

anya.design: We can. Confirming sizes and exports: SVG for diagram (no raster text), PNG@2x for tiles, Figma components with tokens. Any priority order?

miguel.pm: Priority: diagram + long hero first, then square hero, then email headers. Diagram should call out batching, kv-cache, and quantization with icons. Use Redwood palette and a simplified legend.

liz.content: Copy ready; two headline options in figma comments. I'll add alt text for each frame. Avoid the phrase "enterprise-grade" per legal.

figma-bot: File updated by anya.design  frames added, comments enabled.

anya.design: Timeline: wireframes in 18h, first comps in 36h, final exports in 72h. Will include dark-mode social variant and a logo-free partner variant.

sam.marketing: Great. Please include a one-paragraph usage note and a tiny PNG sprite with the three icons for docs.

anya.design: Noted. Will tag reviewers in Figma when comps are up.
